name: ask_question
description:
Ask the user structured questions and wait for answers before continuing.
Ask the user structured questions during the current reply and continue only after they answer. Use only when you genuinely need the user's preference, a clarification, or a decision. A single call may contain multiple questions; options should be mutually exclusive, concise, and carry helpful descriptions. Do not add an "Other" option — the UI provides a custom-answer input by default. Put the recommended option first and mark it "(recommended)" in its label.

header.description: Very short question title, at most 30 characters.

options.description: Answer options; no need to add an "Other" option. May be empty, in which case the user can only type a custom answer.

description.description: Explains what the option means and its implications.

multiple.description: Whether multiple answers may be selected, default false.

custom.description: Whether a custom answer may be entered, default true.
